card.name: Oral dosage form words in dosing
card.fires_on: Words that name or mark the oral form of a drug (tablet, tablets, capsules, orally) in dosing instructions, often right after a drug name or dose. Also the middle of a brand name before 'capsules whole'.

modes.label: Tablet after drug name
modes.description: The word tablet(s) right after a generic drug name in a recommended-dose sentence.

modes.label: Orally after dose
modes.description: The word orally, or the gap before the dose, in a recommended-dosage line.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of VERZENIO is 150 mg<< orally>> twice daily.

modes.label: Inside brand name before capsules
modes.description: Partway through a brand name just before 'capsules whole'.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about medication, pills and prescribing.
card.plain: It marks the spot in dosing text where a drug's oral form, like a tablet or capsule, is being named.
